invitations.heading: Invitation
invitations.subtitle: The owner sets their own password from a one-time link. You never see it.

state.none: No invitation has been issued: this account has no login yet. Creating a link sets one up.
state.pending: Waiting for the owner to set a password. The invitation works until {date}.
state.expired: The invitation expired before the owner used it. Create a new link to let them in.
state.accepted: The owner has set a password and can sign in. There is no invitation left to hand over.

invitations.replaceNote: An e-mail is sent only if this panel has a mail server set up. Creating a link replaces any invitation already sent: the earlier link stops working.
invitations.linkWarning: Shown once. Anyone holding this link can set the account's password, so give it to the owner only. It stops working once the owner uses it, or on {date}. Leaving this page forgets it; create another link if you lose it.
